# Duck Nap Games

> Independent game studio. Official game information, play destinations and support links.

Whose Stuff? Character Quiz is available on Android. Fox on Ice has a browser demo. Contact the studio for Farm Pals Forever availability.

## Games

- [Whose Stuff? Character Quiz](https://ducknapgames.github.io/games/whose-stuff/index.md): Available on Google Play.
- [Fox on Ice](https://ducknapgames.github.io/games/fox-on-ice/index.md): Browser demo available.
- [Farm Pals Forever](https://ducknapgames.github.io/games/farm-pals-forever/index.md): Contact the studio for availability.

## Studio and support

- [Studio overview](https://ducknapgames.github.io/index.md): Games and contact information.
- [Machine-readable game catalog](https://ducknapgames.github.io/games.json): Current names, features, availability and public play links.
- [Support](https://ducknapgames.github.io/support/): Game help and purchase questions.
- [Privacy policies](https://ducknapgames.github.io/privacy/): Game-specific privacy information.
- [Whose Stuff data deletion](https://ducknapgames.github.io/games/whose-stuff/delete-data/): Account and data deletion requests.
